message.reasoning: LC: invoice description enters via tool result — indirect (I). CP: no conversation carryover; fresh message list per invoice; description stored but only re-retrieved → N. AP: single agent, contained → C. RH: no verified episode; proxy is approval decision itself, agent can reach it — Possible (P)? The agent can approve invoices, but is that a proxy/evaluator? The sink is the business action, not an evaluator. RH P plausible. ES: fixed five tools, args not validated → M.
